html:
SMTO-CTR-0019 — A check found your request mentions a file the plan doesn't have

GUID: b7510f35-765a-4160-ab26-6c084a2d2e04
Slug: task-contract-unresolved-attachment
Domain: CTR · Subsystem: task-contract

What happened

  • Your request talks about an attached or uploaded file, but the Task Contract (the plan SMTO writes from a request) isn't linked to any file and didn't ask you about it. The check didn't run or change anything.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Make sure the file is really attached: select Add context, then Add files to conversation, and choose the file before sending. Saying a file is attached doesn't attach it; the plan can only use files that were actually added.
  2. If you didn't mean to attach anything, reword the request so it doesn't say attached, uploaded or provided document. The check expects a real file whenever the request says one is attached.
  3. Send the request again as a new message so SMTO writes a new plan linked to the file. Once the file is attached, it's safe to try again, and the new plan is checked from scratch.

What success looks like

  • The check passes for the new Task Contract, or the new task shows Task contract generated and starts working.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with your request text and the file name, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't let a task guess what a missing file contains.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Offline validate_contract found attachment-dependent source wording (attached, attachment, uploaded, provided document) with no authoritative references, or an unresolved attachment placeholder, and no clarification request.

What this means

  • Offline validation sees attachment-dependent source or unresolved attachment placeholders without authoritative references and without a clarification request. This condition is produced by an explicit offline contract diagnostic, not the current compiler acceptance gate. It reports only the named check and cannot authorize execution or prove complete semantic fidelity.

Why this can happen

  • Offline validation sees attachment-dependent source or unresolved attachment placeholders without authoritative references and without a clarification request.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare attachment intent, granted references and clarification state; never invent missing document contents.

How to fix it

  • validate_contract in src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_models.py raised unresolved_attachment: clarification.needed is false while the source mentions an attachment and authoritative_references is empty, or the rendered contract contains attached_reference, uploaded_file or provided_file. Attach the intended file so it appears in the context manifest, or have the contract request clarification; never invent the missing document's contents.
  • Select the intended attachment or clarify its absence through the supported task flow.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The actual source is selected or the missing attachment is explicitly clarified.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • This condition is produced by an explicit offline contract diagnostic, not the current compiler acceptance gate. It reports only the named check and cannot authorize execution or prove complete semantic fidelity.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
